summary.intent: Get the full quality gate passing for work package S (git boundary work in the wp-s-git-boundary worktree), then run mutation testing on the resulting diff.
summary.outcome: The full gate failed on a pre-mode test, which was fixed by updating its fake git to match the literal pathspec. The gate was rerun and passed (exit 0), the fix was committed, and cargo mutants was started on the S diff. Its result is not shown in the transcript.

repo: The full gate for a work package runs as a background command and reports via task notifications (non-zero exit 100 on failure).
Tests in crates/callisto-cli/tests use a fake git binary that matches on argument strings, so changes to how git is invoked, such as using literal pathspecs, can break those tests.
Work package S is developed in a separate worktree at .claude/worktrees/wp-s-git-boundary.

code.finding: The fake git in the pre-mode tests matched the raw `.changeset/pre.json` argument and had to be updated to match the literal pathspec form the production code now passes. Exact line numbers are not given in the transcript.

workflow: Run the full gate in the background and inspect the failing output to find the specific failing test before fixing.
Re-run the targeted test file (pre_mode_tests) before re-running the full gate to confirm the fix cheaply.
Commit the fix once the gate is green, then run cargo mutants scoped to the Rust diff rather than the whole codebase.
